mission: To help small businesses by providing access to quality engineering and the same technical solutions large companies use to stay ahead.
aboutText: We rebuild your website to better reflect your business. We run our audit so local searches can lead customers straight to you.

services.name: AEO & SEO Website Audit
services.description: An in-depth look at why local customers might be missing your business online. We uncover why search engines and AI assistants are skipping over your website.

services.name: Custom Web Design & Development
services.description: Clean custom code and modern website redesigns engineered for fast page loads, AI search recommendations and customer conversion.

services.name: Hosting & Administration
services.description: Fast, quality cloud hosting and ongoing technical care. We handle your website's speed, security, backups and regular content updates for you behind the scenes.
